name: Yoon Doo-joon
bio: Yoon Doo-jun (윤두준) is a South Korean singer and actor. He is the leader of the South Korean boy group Highlight.

credits.title: The Catstody War
credits.overview: Married couple in their 5th year of marriage, about to get divorced, and their conflict over the 'cat rights' of a cat that is like a child to them.

credits.title: HIGHLIGHT: LIGHTS GO ON, AGAIN IN CINEMA
credits.overview: Step into HIGHLIGHT’s extraordinary 15-year journey as they bring their anniversary concert in Seoul to theaters worldwide. Experience unforgettable performances of fan-favorites like "Plz Don’t Be Sad," "BODY," "Bad Girl," "Shock," and "Fiction," all woven into a narrative that captures their past, present, and future

credits.title: Honest Candidate 2
credits.overview: As a politician, Joo Sang-Sook (Ra Mi-Ran) attempted to run for the fourth time as a member of the nationally assembly. After visiting her grandmother, Joo Sang-Sook was unable to tell a lie. Now, Joo Sang-Sook attempts to return to the political world.

credits.title: Return of the Mafia
credits.overview: Three former mafia members work at a construction company to avoid getting involved in the underworld again. But fates draw them back to the past when a gangster approaches one of them.
